purpose: One-beat captain override intake. Captain orders preempt idle ship/computer work. Mailbox is incoming command; night orders remain standing watch policy.

roles.mailbox: CPU intake for captain orders that hit the deck

distinct_from.night_orders: standing watch policy while captain is away
distinct_from.captain_bridge: separate bridge surface; do not merge
distinct_from.inbox_outbox: organism ask/mission board; mailbox is sealed command intake

dispositions.pending: allowed command admitted to mailbox; idle work must yield
dispositions.HOLD: denied or unknown command recorded; not executed; does not preempt

preempt.rule: true iff at least one pending allowed captain order exists
preempt.night_watch_yield: HOLD lamp with PREEMPT disposition; do not assemble; do not invent work
